escenas.texto: This week in Europe, millions of people watched, commented and shared non-stop. The thirty videos in this countdown add up to over five hundred and five million views. But only one took number one. Welcome to Top 10 Social Media, Europe edition. Today: the ten most viewed, the ten most commented and the ten most liked videos of the week. Stay until the end, because you won't guess number one.

The rules, quick and clear. Only videos posted in the last seven days that trended in Europe. One video per creator on each list. Music and news have their own space. Every number comes from the official YouTube API, measured this Sunday. Let's go.

Let's start with the ten most viewed videos. Number ten, from Poland, Polina, with a video posted five days ago. Over ten million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just seventeen seconds.

In position number nine, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over ten million views. A Short of just fifty-four seconds. It also has over six thousand comments.
Coming in at number eight, from Netherlands, Ayse Acun, with “the best way to do a claw clip half up half down”. Over ten million views. A Short of just seven seconds. It also has sixty comments.
Number seven, from Germany, Peakzmotivation, with “This Nerf Dart Just REFUSES To Fall...”. Over ten million views. A Short of just fifty-eight seconds. It also has over one thousand comments.
In position number six, from Spain, YoSoyDander, with a video posted four days ago. Over fourteen million views. A Short of just nineteen seconds. It also has eighty-one comments.

Coming in at number five, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted two days ago. Over fourteen million views. It has the best engagement rate on this list: three out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

In position number four, from Türkiye, Food Therapy, with “How to Dice an Onion Like a Pro”. Over fourteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Events Untold, with “Why Giant Pandas Spend 12 Hours Eating”. Over sixteen million views. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.

Silver medal, Deiva Divine, with a video posted six days ago. Over twenty-five million views. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and forty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over one thousand comments.

Drum roll, please. Number one most viewed, from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with a video posted six days ago. Over eighty-two million views. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. It also has over three thousand comments.

Now for the conversation: the ten most commented videos. Number ten, from Poland, Vandiril, with “League Bans are getting SCARY...”. Over three thousand comments. It got there in just one day. It also has over seven hundred and seventy-six thousand views.
In position number nine, from United Kingdom, The Critical Gamer, with “BioWare - Another Domino Falls”. Over three thousand comments. It also has over seven hundred and thirty-seven thousand views.

Number eight, from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with a video posted six days ago. Over three thousand comments. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. It also has over eighty-two million views.

Next up, number seven, Jazzghost, with a video posted four days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over forty-two minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It also has over three point two million views.

At number six, from Türkiye, Bakirkertenkele31, with a video posted two days ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over thirty-eight minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

Number five, from United Kingdom, BULKHEAD, with “The hotzone ep 1 the wipe”. Over four thousand comments. And get this: it's a channel with about one hundred and twenty thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A video over seventy minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

Next up, number four, from Ukraine, Domer Grief, with a video posted one day ago. Over four thousand comments. A video over twenty-three minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just one day.
Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over six thousand comments. A Short of just fifty-four seconds. It also has over ten million views.

Silver medal, from Türkiye, Vural Üzül, with a video posted three days ago. Over fourteen thousand comments. It has the best engagement rate on this list: sixteen out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A video over forty-nine minutes long, and people still stayed to watch.

And finally, number one most commented, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted two days ago. Over twenty-four thousand comments. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

And the last list: the ten most liked videos. Coming in at number ten, from Poland, Things Opened, with “How a USB-C Cable Really Works”. Over one hundred and sixty-six thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about eleven thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. It also has over five point nine million views.

At number nine, Kayla Ryan, with “does this count as full circle THANK YOU for this opportunity!!”. Over one hundred and seventy thousand likes. A Short of just eleven seconds. It also has over eight point nine million views.

At number eight, from Germany, Peakzmotivation, with “This Nerf Dart Just REFUSES To Fall...”. Over one hundred and eighty-five thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-eight seconds. It also has over ten million views.

In position number seven, from Türkiye, Food Therapy, with “How to Dice an Onion Like a Pro”. Over two hundred and eighteen thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about forty-two thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just thirty-one seconds.

At number six, from United Kingdom, Helen Christie, with “Flappers did WHAT!?”. Over two hundred and forty-eight thousand likes. A Short of just twenty-three seconds. It also has over nine point five million views.

In position number five, from United Kingdom, Events Untold, with “Why Giant Pandas Spend 12 Hours Eating”. Over two hundred and ninety-one thousand likes. And get this: it's a channel with about fifty-five thousand subscribers, playing in the big leagues this week. A Short of just eight seconds.

Coming in at number four, from Spain, Jajamaru, with a video posted four days ago. Over three hundred and ten thousand likes. It has the best engagement rate on this list: four out of every hundred viewers liked or commented. A Short of just twenty-seven seconds.

Bronze medal, from United Kingdom, Mrwhosetheboss, with “6 ways iPhone Duo beats Samsung”. Over three hundred and thirty-two thousand likes. A Short of just fifty-four seconds. It also has over ten million views.

Silver medal, from Germany, Dhruv Rathee, with a video posted two days ago. Over four hundred and seventy-six thousand likes. A video over twenty minutes long, and people still stayed to watch. It got there in just two days.

And here it is. Number one most liked, from Cyprus, Crafter Duck GARAGE, with a video posted six days ago. Over one million likes. It was the fastest-growing video on this list: about five hundred and fifty thousand views per hour. It also has over eighty-two million views.

And the world tour isn't over. Next stop: the Americas. The link is in the description and in the playlist. Now it's your turn: which video should have made this countdown? Tell us in the comments with the hashtag Top10RS. Links to every original video are in the description: go support the creators. Subscribe and hit the bell. A new Top 10 every Sunday.
